name: Get Lucky
plainLyrics:
Morning light on the harbour wall
Gulls above the ferry call
Coffee cooling on the sill
The kettle sings, the street is still

We walk the long way into town
Past the bakery, up and down
Every window wakes in turn
Every lamp has learned to burn

Hold the tune and keep the time
Every step a little rhyme
Hold the tune and keep the time
Carry on and you'll be fine

Evening folds the market stalls
Shadows lean on painted walls
Someone hums a borrowed song
And the whole street hums along

Hold the tune and keep the time
Every step a little rhyme
Hold the tune and keep the time
Carry on and you'll be fine
